P.name: Whisper
P.title: Template:Data Jhin/Whisper
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Whisper|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jhin
|skill        = I
|icon         = Whisper.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate - Death in 4 Acts:}} {{cis|Jhin}} gun may fire up to 4 times before needing to reload for a short period. The final round will {{tip|critically strike}}, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Innate - Every Moment Matters:}} '''Jhin''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, increased by his {{sti|critical strike chance}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. Whenever he {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, he gains a burst of {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} based on his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
|blurb4       = '''Jhin's''' {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}} cannot increase except by {{sti|xp|leveling}} up, and he deals reduced {{tip|critically strike|critical strike damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate - Death In 4 Acts:}} '''Jhin's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} consume [[ammunition]] within 4 rounds. He will reload over {{fd|2.5}} seconds immediately after expending all rounds or withholding leftover rounds after 10 seconds of being [[out of combat]] and not being affected by {{tip|crowd control}}. The latter reload can be interrupted by declaring an attack or casting an ability. '''Jhin''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time.
|description2 = '''Jhin's''' final round attack has an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, always {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, including against {{tip|turrets|structures}}, and deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|15 to 25 for 3|1 to 11}} of the target's {{sti|'''missing''' health}}}}. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 800 against {{tip|monsters}}.
|description3 = {{sbc|Innate - Every Moment Matters:}} '''Jhin''' gains {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|4;5;6;7;8;9;10;11;12;14;16;20;24;28;32;36;40;44|formula = 4% at + 1% per level up to 9, then + 2% up to 11, then + 4%, capped at level 18}}|attack damage}}<!--stops at 18-->{{ft|{{as|(+ {{fd|0.35}}% per 1% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.3}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}|{{as|(+ 35% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}{{as|AD}}. 
|description4 = Additionally, {{tip|critical strikes}} against enemies grant '''Jhin''' {{as|14%|movement speed}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.44}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Jhin_Original_P4Ready_4.ogg}} ''"One, two, three, four, two, two, three, four."''
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|parry        = true
|spelleffects = Proc
|notes        = 
* The {{as|{{sti|'''missing''' health}}}} damage benefits from {{sti|life steal}}.
* The '''bonus''' damage based on the target's missing health does not affect structures.
* The 4th attack versus a structure is classified as a critical strike.
* The attack damage multiplier stacks additively with {{bi|Dragon Slayer|Dragon Slayer's}}.
* ''Every Moment Matters' '' bonus {{as|AD}} will benefit from any amount of {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}, even in excess of an amount that would usually reach the attacks per second cap ({{fd|3}}).
** The maximum modifier without attack speed is 79%.
*** 44% base modifier at level 18.
*** 35% from critical strike chance on account of the 100% cap.
*** [[Attack speed#Reducing attack speed|Attack speed slows]] will not affect '''Jhin's''' bonus attack damage from his passive and will ignore his attack speed as it is fixed.
* Attack damage reductions apply before the multiplier causing them to be stronger against '''Jhin''' than advertised or versus other champions.
}}

W.name: Deadly Flourish
W.title: Template:Data Jhin/Deadly Flourish
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Deadly Flourish|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jhin
|skill        = W
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} Enemy champions that trigger a ''{{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin|Lotus Trap}}'', or take damage from {{ci|Jhin}} or his allies, are marked with [[File: Caught Out.png|20px|link=]] ''Caught Out'' for a few seconds.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
|blurb3       = Hitting a marked [[File: Caught Out.png|20px|link=]] ''Caught Out'' champion {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration and grants '''Jhin''' ''{{ai|Whisper|Jhin|Every Moment Matters'}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.
|description  = {{Anchor|Caught Out}}{{sbc|Passive:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} that trigger a ''{{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin|Lotus Trap}}'' to bloom or are damaged by '''Jhin''' or allied champions are ''marked'' for 4 seconds.
|icon2        = Deadly Flourish.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy champion, reduced by 25% against {{tip|minions}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 50% AD)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70*0.75 to 210*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{fd|37.5}}% AD)}}}}
|icon3        = Caught Out.png
|description3 = Hitting a ''marked'' champion {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration and grants '''Jhin''' {{ais|Whisper|Jhin|Every Moment Matters}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.25 to 2.25}} seconds}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.75}}
|cooldown     = 12
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 70}}
|costtype     = Mana
|range        = {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|2520|Estimated}}|{{tt|-20|Backwards range}}}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 80
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = Special
|spellshield  = True
|projectile   = True
|knockdown    = 
|grounded     = 
|notes        = 
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the enemy champion and {{tip|area damage}} to all other enemy units.
* The ''Caught Out'' mark only appears if ''Deadly Flourish'' can potentially {{tip|root}} the target, and will not if the ability's cooldown is longer than 4 seconds or isn't ranked up.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* The ability will not preserve the caster's facing direction when using {{si|Flash}} and similar effects.
* Uniquely, ''Deadly Flourish'' is special-cased to be {{tip|projectile|intercepted}} by valid counters because it looks like a blockable missile, even though it functionally is not a missile.
* While {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguised}} as a non-champion, {{ci|Neeko}} cannot be affected by ''Deadly Flourish''.{{bug}}
}}

E.name: Captive Audience
E.title: Template:Data Jhin/Captive Audience
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Captive Audience|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jhin
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive - Beauty in Death:}} Killing an enemy champion summons a free ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' under them.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jhin}} places a {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location. When an enemy crosses, it will ''bloom'', {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them. The trap detonates shortly after, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies.
|blurb3       = '''Jhin''' stocks a ''Lotus Trap'' every few seconds, holding up to two.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive - Beauty in Death:}} Whenever '''Jhin''' kills an enemy champion, he summons a ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' on their corpse.
|icon2        = Captive Audience.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' places a ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location which, upon landing, becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 180 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The ''Lotus Trap blooms'' upon enemy contact, with enemies in the area at the time of its trigger becoming {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 4 seconds.
|description3 = '''Jhin''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Lotus Trap'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
|description4 = ''Blooming Lotus Traps'' {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies. ''Lotus Traps'' deal 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} as well as against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} who have been struck by another ''Lotus Trap'' in the last 1 second.
|leveling4    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 260}} {{as|(+ 120% AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|20*0.65 to 260*0.65}} {{as|(+ 78% AD)}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}}}
|description5 = ''See [[Jhin#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Lotus Traps.''
|cooldown     = 2
|recharge     = {{ap|24 to 14}}
|cost         = 30
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = Mana + 1 Charge
|target range = 750
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|260|On-trigger reveal and explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|260|Trap sight radius}}}}
|collision radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|160|Trigger radius}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = Special
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* ''Beauty in Death'' does not consume ''Lotus Trap'' charges.
* The ''Lotus Trap'' will stop upon encountering a {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} or {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
* ''Beauty in Death'' does not trigger after killing a {{tip|clone}}.
* The reveal debuff is named [[File: Caught Out.png|20px|link=]] ''Caught Out''.
** This debuff is shared between ''Captive Audience'' and {{ai|Curtain Call|Jhin}}.
}}

R.title: Template:Data Jhin/Curtain Call
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Curtain Call|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jhin
|skill        = R
|icon         = Curtain Call.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jhin}} {{tip|channels}} up to a period, being able to fire up to four shots in a large cone in front of him.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}. It stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for a short time.
|blurb3       = The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|blurb4       = ''Curtain Call'' plays music globally when first activated and its range is always {{tip|obscured|visible}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, transforming his weapon into a cannon and gaining the ability to recast ''Curtain Call'' 4 times within the duration.
|icon2        = Curtain Call 2.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} After {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time, '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health.}}}}. The bullet stops upon hitting an enemy champion, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. Each cast has a {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} of 1 second.
|leveling2    = {{st|Minimum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|64 to 192}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|64*4 to 192*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*4}}% AD)}}}}
|icon3        = Curtain Call 3.png
|description3 = The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
|leveling3    = {{st|Minimum Fourth Shot Damage|{{ap|64*2 to 192*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*2}}% AD)}}|Maximum Fourth Shot Damage|{{ap|(64*2)*4 to (192*2)*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25*2)*4}}% AD)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 90}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = {{dv|{{tt|1|Active}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Recast}}}}
|range        = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|3500|Missile range}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|160|Missile width}}
|speed        = 5000
|angle        = {{tt|60{{degree}}|Estimated}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = Special
|spellshield  = True
|projectile   = True
|silence      = true
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Jhin_Original_R_1.ogg}} ''"Prepare... for your finale."''
|notes        = 
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to enemy champions and {{tip|area damage}} to other enemy units.
*Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Curtain Call's'' shooting range is fixed in front of '''Jhin'''.
* The opening sound effect and area of range are audible and visible to both teams.
* Leveling up the ability while channeling will change the final cooldown.
* '''Jhin''' will turn to face in the target direction whenever he uses a recast.
* '''Jhin''' gains a wider field of view during ''Curtain Call''.
* The reveal debuff is named [[File: Caught Out.png|20px|link=]] ''Caught Out''.
** This debuff is shared between {{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin}} and ''Curtain Call''.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
<!--Bullet travel speed approx 3200? -->

}}
